title: Kite (KITE) Price Analysis and Scenarios
content:

Current price is $0.2205, market [cap](/cap-4) is $497.84M, and the 30-day move is +59.73%. This report uses market data, ATH distance, volume quality, and TokenRadar metrics to define what would strengthen or weaken the setup.

## Current Price Setup

Kite trades at $0.2205 with a market [cap](/cap-4) of $497.84M and 24h volume of $119.81M. The latest ranked market snapshot places KITE at #107 by market capitalization. The token is -31.57% from its all-time high of $0.3197, recorded on March 6, 2026. Its all-time low is $0.0618, recorded on November 4, 2025, while the 30-day move is +59.73%. Circulating supply is 2,273,255,814, total supply is 10,000,000,000, and max supply is 10,000,000,000. Current 24h range runs from $0.1954 to $0.2267, while 24h change is +11.75%. That short-term move should be compared with 7-day performance of +42.56% and 30-day performance of +59.73% before drawing conclusions.

## Scenario Framework

The constructive scenario for KITE requires improving volume, stable or rising market rank, and price action that holds above recent weak sessions. The neutral scenario is range-bound trading where market [cap](/cap-4) and volume do not confirm a strong trend. The downside scenario is a breakdown in liquidity, a weaker category backdrop, or renewed movement toward the all-time low of $0.0618 from November 4, 2025.

## Risk and Volatility Inputs

TokenRadar currently assigns Kite a risk score of 5/10, a growth potential index of 36/100, narrative strength of 95/100, and a volatility index of 56/100. The computed risk level is medium. Kite is a strong narrative token.

Volatility matters because a percentage move can look attractive while still being unsupported by liquidity. The current volume-to-market-[cap](/cap-4) ratio is 24.07%, and the ATH drawdown is -31.57% from $0.3197. Those two data points help frame whether the market is [liquid](/liquid) enough and whether the price is recovering from a deep historical decline.

## Market Cap and Supply Pressure

Kite has market [cap](/cap-4) of $497.84M and FDV of $2.19B. Circulating supply is 2,273,255,814, total supply is 10,000,000,000, and max supply is 10,000,000,000. If FDV is much larger than market [cap](/cap-4), future supply can matter as much as chart momentum. If max supply is fixed, the analysis should still check circulating supply and unlock schedules.

## What Would Improve the Outlook

The outlook would improve if KITE shows stronger volume than its recent baseline, improving 7-day and 30-day trend alignment, clearer project execution, and no major negative security or governance events. A move supported by volume is generally more useful than a price spike with weak turnover.

## What Would Weaken the Outlook

The outlook would weaken if price rises while volume falls, if market rank deteriorates, if liquidity becomes fragmented, or if supply data changes without clear disclosure. For high-risk tokens, a positive 24h move can still be a weak signal when the broader trend, ATH distance, and volume ratio do not confirm it.

## FAQ

**Can Kite price be predicted exactly?**

No. This article uses scenarios and invalidation points rather than exact price targets because crypto markets are volatile and liquidity can change quickly.

**What is the current KITE price?**

The latest local data snapshot shows KITE at $0.2205 with a 24h move of +11.75%.

**What would make the KITE setup stronger?**

Improving volume, stable market rank, stronger 30-day trend, and credible project catalysts would make the setup cleaner.

**What is the main risk in this analysis?**

The main risk is treating a short-term price move as confirmation without checking liquidity, supply, volatility, and project-specific events.

## Continue Research

Use this KITE scenario analysis together with the [live Kite overview](/kite-2) and the [buying checklist](/kite-2/how-to-buy). A forecast is more useful when it is tied to market cap, liquidity, risk score, custody planning, and current execution costs. If the setup depends on future supply, review [FDV and dilution](/learn/fully-diluted-valuation-fdv); if it depends on trade execution, review [liquidity depth](/learn/liquidity-depth) before treating the scenario as actionable research.

For KITE research, the important control is consistency between the live market snapshot and the longer historical record. A single 24h move can be noisy, while market cap rank, 30-day performance, all-time high distance, supply structure, and volume-to-cap ratio create a more durable comparison set. This is why the article separates market data from decision rules and keeps the conclusion conditional.

Kite also needs category-aware interpretation. A Artificial Intelligence (AI) token with high liquidity can behave very differently from a low-volume asset with the same percentage move. The practical question is whether volume, spread quality, supply data, and catalyst evidence confirm the move or contradict it.

The safest way to use this price prediction article is as a checklist. Confirm the latest price, check the current rank, compare 24h volume with market cap, review the ATH and ATL dates, and look for any project-specific changes before treating the data as current enough for research.
